purpose: jenscolt's base as parameters: only the outer bowl, its rim and the leg notches (Morante, 2026-11-20); his inside (posts, motor and light mounts, static-leg tabs) is left out, our mechanism goes there at N2. Reference: the derived bowl (derive_bowl.py).
pass_criterion: the default fidelity gate passes, the sweep's variants are valid solids, and the judge scores ≥ 0.70 against the mesh
must_have: bowl skin and wall thickness separate parameters
the rim notches (leg windows) as named features, one parameter set mirrored left/right
must_not: build.py reads a mesh: the reference meshes are read only by the gates and the designer's probes

references.label: the reference mesh(es) to reproduce, same four views and framing

gates.name: fidelity-base
gates.note: visible from below and the sides only: the body covers the base's top; the bowl's inside is ours (N2)
